first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a guarded onboarding simplification test the most direct response. Apply it to self-serve and simpler workspaces, while preserving the full flow for complex-workspace accounts because of the known early-churn risk. Verify activation-messaging results as a lower-risk comparison and monitor qualified revenue, activation, completion, and 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Use the slot for a standard activation-messaging experiment. The verified result showed +6% activation, +11% week-one engagement, and a +1% improvement in 30-day retention, making it the strongest available option for sustainable qualified revenue while activation is declining. Do not shorten onboarding broadly: its completion and time-to-value gains are offset by materially higher churn in complex-workspace accounts. Measure activation, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention against a holdout.
